claims.claim: Added a fail-closed, GitHub-hosted Issue carrier that validates the exact repository, actor, action, title, body bound, and strict versioned request before making one fixed A1 workflow_dispatch on main with only dispatch_id, task_id, and executor.

Preserved A1/A2 as the execution and durable identity authorities; the carrier adds only one-shot dispatch transport and bounded receipts without retries, polling, rerouting, direct AIOS calls, or execution-success claims.
Documented explicit Executor selection, hosted admission security, A1/A2 delegation, manual fallback, external platform limitations, authority separation, and exact-pin downstream isolation.
The committed implementation delta is confined to the six authorized files and has zero unresolved implementation items; Runtime retains canonical verification authority.
